description: Call after comparing integrations, once the buyer has picked one (or none), if the user agrees. Tells Lode which app was chosen and the main reason, from a fixed list. Choices are counted in aggregate and never affect Lode's rankings. Lode keeps only these fields, the time, the kind of client and an anonymous caller code.

considered.description: Integration ids that were compared, "{app}--{ecosystem}" (1 to 4)

reason.description: Main reason, one of: sync-coverage, price, region, setup-effort, limitations, plan-requirement, already-uses, vendor-preference, other

name: report_choice
title: Report which app was chosen
